passages.text:
Hi All,
Just for your SA. I'm being intro'd to a bunch of folks in CPC for intros which I think is good. Any thoughts are welcome
before I start these rounds.
For background:
Julie Werbel who l've known for over a decade reached out and pinged me and facilitated all of this.
On CMC- I've worked a ton with COCOMs in my prior life and SOF, so a bit of a familiar territory.
I know OTI has a lot of disinfo programminh as well.
Cheers, Vera
..___- Forwarded message ---

Hi All,
Just for your SA. I'm being intro'd to a bunch of folks in CPC for intros which I think is good. Any thoughts are welcome
before I start these rounds.
For background:
Julie Werbel who l've known for over a decade reached out and pinged me and facilitated all of this.
On CMC- I've worked a ton with COCOMs in my prior life and SOF, so a bit of a familiar territory.
I know OTI has a lot of disinfo programminh as well.
Cheers, Vera
..___- Forwarded message ---
From: Ciara Knudsen <[contact omitted]>
Date: Wed, May 11, 2022 at 2:08 PM
Subject: Fwd: New Senior Advisor for Technology and Democray
To: Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>
CC: Timothy Marlowe<[contact omitted]>, Charles (Will) Lewis <[contact omitted]>, Randy McClendon
<[contact omitted] Gross<[contact omitted]>, Shirley Min <[contact omitted]>. [opaque block]
[opaque block] [opaque block] >, Pauline Melvin <[contact omitted]>, Brian Murawsky
<[contact omitted]>, Angela Greenewald <[contact omitted], Ryan McCannell <[contact omitted]>
In addition to the welcome from broader CPS, I wanted to introduce you to the crew working on Disinformation in the
Office of Civilian Military Cooperation (CMC). We run the USAID relationship with DOD and our folks in DC, the Pentagon,
and at each of the COCOMs are working on USAID and DOD interests in this disinformation/technology/
security/governance space every day. We would love to connect with you on what opportunities we are pursuing and
some of the challenges we're grappling with. So you know on this email - we have:
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
[opaque block]
Each of these team members are working on these issues every day - and supporting the USAID teams at the combatant
commands who are focused on civ-mil efforts in the field. Our EUCOM team in particular right now is highly focused on
this set of issues as they engage in planning for next steps in Eastern Europe.
We would love to connect as you make your rounds and support your work on this important issue!
best,
Ciara (CMC Director)
